# iosxe_voice_service_voip (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Service VoIP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_service_voip" "example" {
  type                                        = "voip"
  address_hiding                              = true
  media_bulk_stats                            = true
  media_statistics                            = true
  media_disable_detailed_stats                = true
  mode_border_element                         = true
  allow_connections_sip_to_sip                = true
  redirect_ip2ip                              = true
  rtcp_keepalive                              = true
  dtmf_interworking                           = "rtp-nte"
  gcid                                        = true
  rtcp_all_pass_through                       = true
  ip_address_trusted_authenticate             = true
  srtp_fallback                               = true
  supplementary_service_sip_moved_temporarily = true
  supplementary_service_sip_handle_replaces   = true
  supplementary_service_media_renegotiate     = true
  fax_protocol                                = "t38"
  trace                                       = true
  stun_flowdata_agent_id                      = 1
  stun_flowdata_boot_count                    = 6
  sip_session_refresh                         = true
  sip_session_transport_tcp_tls               = true
  sip_header_passing                          = true
  sip_error_passthru                          = true
  sip_referto_passing                         = true
  sip_asserted_id_pai                         = true
  sip_asymmetric_payload_full                 = true
  sip_srtp_negotiate_cisco                    = true
  sip_early_offer_forced                      = true
  sip_pass_thru_headers_unsupp                = true
  sip_pass_thru_content_unsupp                = true
  sip_audio_forced                            = true
  sip_contact_passing                         = true
  sip_requri_passing                          = true
  sip_update_callerid                         = true
  sip_anat                                    = false
  sip_g729_annexb_all                         = true
  sip_privacy_policy_passthru                 = true
  sip_conn_reuse                              = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) - Choices: `pots`, `saf`, `voatm`, `vofr`, `voip`

### Optional

- `address_hiding` (Boolean) Address hiding (SIP-SIP)
- `allow_connections_sip_to_sip` (Boolean) to-type sip
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `dtmf_interworking` (String) Dtmf Interworking
  - Choices: `rtp-nte`, `standard`
- `emergency` (String) List of Emergency Numbers
- `fax_fallback` (String) fax transport to use if T.38 unsupported on far end
  - Choices: `cisco`, `none`, `pass-through`
- `fax_protocol` (String) The system-wide fax protocol type
  - Choices: `cisco`, `none`, `pass-through`, `t38`
- `gcid` (Boolean) Enable Global Call Identification for voip
- `ip_address_trusted_authenticate` (Boolean) ip address trusted (toll fraud prevention) authenticate control flag
- `ip_address_trusted_call_block` (Boolean) ip address trusted (toll fraud prevention) call-block
- `ip_address_trusted_list_ipv4` (Attributes List) ip address trusted (toll fraud prevention) list entry (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_address_trusted_list_ipv4))
- `media_bulk_stats` (Boolean) Retrieve bulk statistics is enabled
- `media_disable_detailed_stats` (Boolean) Disable detailed stats collection about the calls present
- `media_statistics` (Boolean) Media statistics is enabled
- `mode_border_element` (Boolean) Mode setting for Border-Element
- `redirect_ip2ip` (Boolean) Redirect IP-to-IP calls
- `redundancy_group` (Number) Associate redundancy-group with voice HA
  - Range: `1`-`2`
- `rtcp_all_pass_through` (Boolean) Pass through all the rtcp in datapath
- `rtcp_keepalive` (Boolean) Generate RTCP keepalive report
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Stop VoIP services gracefully without dropping active calls
- `sip_anat` (Boolean) Allow alternative network address types IPv4 and IPv6
- `sip_asserted_id_pai` (Boolean) Use privacy asserted identity
- `sip_asymmetric_payload_full` (Boolean) Asymmetric Support for dynamic codec and dtmf payloads
- `sip_audio_forced` (Boolean) Allow only audio/fax, drop all other
- `sip_bind_control_source_interface` (String) GigabitEthernet IEEE 802.3z
- `sip_bind_control_source_interface_loopback` (Number) Loopback interface
  - Range: `0`-`2147483647`
- `sip_bind_control_source_interface_port_channel` (Number) Ethernet Channel of interfaces
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `sip_bind_control_source_interface_ten_gigabit_ethernet` (String) Ten Gigabit Ethernet
- `sip_bind_media_source_interface` (String) GigabitEthernet IEEE 802.3z
- `sip_bind_media_source_interface_loopback` (Number) Loopback interface
  - Range: `0`-`2147483647`
- `sip_bind_media_source_interface_port_channel` (Number) Ethernet Channel of interfaces
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `sip_bind_media_source_interface_ten_gigabit_ethernet` (String) Ten Gigabit Ethernet
- `sip_call_service_stop` (Boolean) Stop SIP service - Active calls not affected
- `sip_conn_reuse` (Boolean) reuse the sip registration tcp connection for the end-point behind a Firewall
- `sip_contact_passing` (Boolean) 302 contact needs to be passed through for CFWD
- `sip_early_offer_forced` (Boolean) Forcefully Send Early-Offer
- `sip_error_passthru` (Boolean) SIP error response pass-thru functionality
- `sip_g729_annexb_all` (Boolean) g729b representing g729a and g729b to interop with CCM
- `sip_header_passing` (Boolean) SIP Headers need to be passed to Applications
- `sip_localhost` (String) Specify the DNS name for the localhost
- `sip_midcall_signaling_passthru` (Boolean) Passthrough SIP messages from one IP leg to another IP leg
- `sip_pass_thru_content_sdp` (String) Set Pass-through sdp mode
  - Choices: `non-rtp`
- `sip_pass_thru_content_unsupp` (Boolean) Pass-through all unsupported content
- `sip_pass_thru_headers_unsupp` (Boolean) Pass-through all unsupported headers
- `sip_privacy_policy_passthru` (Boolean) Pass through privacy values received from peer leg
- `sip_referto_passing` (Boolean) Refer-To needs to be passed through for transfer
- `sip_registrar_server_expires_max` (Number) Default registration max expires time
  - Range: `120`-`86400`
- `sip_registrar_server_expires_min` (Number) Default registration min expires time
  - Range: `60`-`3600`
- `sip_requri_passing` (Boolean) Request URI needs to be passed through
- `sip_session_refresh` (Boolean) Enable SIP session timer
- `sip_session_transport_tcp_tls` (Boolean) Transport Layer Protocol - TLS over TCP
- `sip_sip_profiles` (String) The sip profiles tag number to be linked as global
- `sip_sip_profiles_inbound` (String) The sip profiles tag number to be linked as global
- `sip_sip_profiles_inbound_enable` (Boolean) Turn on inbound SIP profiles feature
- `sip_srtp_negotiate_cisco` (Boolean) allow RTP answer to SRTP offer
- `sip_update_callerid` (Boolean) Enable sending updates for callerid
- `srtp_fallback` (Boolean) Allow Secure calls fallback to non secure
- `stun_flowdata_agent_id` (Number) Set Authorization Agent Id
  - Range: `0`-`255`
- `stun_flowdata_boot_count` (Number) Set boot count
  - Range: `0`-`65535`
- `supplementary_service_media_renegotiate` (Boolean) Enable/disable Media Renegotiation
- `supplementary_service_sip_handle_replaces` (Boolean) Handle INVITE with REPLACES header (SIP-SIP only)
- `supplementary_service_sip_moved_temporarily` (Boolean) enable/disable sip moved-temporarily
- `supplementary_service_sip_refer` (Boolean) enable/disable sip refer
- `trace` (Boolean) Voip Trace configuration
- `trace_shutdown` (Boolean) Shut Voip Trace debugging

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_service_voip.example "<type>"
```
